title: On the Necessity of Logarithmic Estimates for Hypoellipticity
summary: This paper is focused on necessary conditions for hypoellipticity of an operator $L$ of the form $L=L_1(x)+g(x)L_2(y)$, where the operator $L_1$ is either elliptic or parabolic, $L_2$ is degenerately elliptic and $g(x)$ may itself vanish adding further degeneracy. First, we establish a logarithmic criterion: if the operator $L$ above is hypoelliptic and $L_1$ has a family of spectral solutions we define in the paper, then the remaining part $L_2$ must gain a power of a logarithm of a derivative.
